title: 1. Realistic initial objective
text:
WEEK GOAL
1-8: If you are overweight, a loss of 5% to 7% of initial weight already improves glucose, tension and cardiometabolic profile. FOCUS: Don't look for perfection, look for daily consistency.
source: NIDDK - Healthy Living with Diabetes; NIDDK - Prediabetes and Insulin Resistance
warning: No hagas dietas extremas sin supervision profesional, especialmente si tomas medicacion para diabetes.

title: 2. Plate method at each meal
text:
PLATE
50-25-25: Fill half a plate with non-starchy vegetables, a quarter with lean protein and a quarter with fiber carbohydrates. BENEFIT: You control portion and glucose without counting everything to the gram.
warning: Si usas insulina en pauta ajustada por raciones, valida cambios con tu equipo de diabetes.

title: 3. Base drink: water
text: PRIORITY: Use water as the main drink during the day. CALORIE CUT: Changing soft drinks and sugary drinks for water reduces free sugar and helps with calorie deficit.
warning: Si tienes enfermedad renal o cardiaca, ajusta liquidos segun indicacion medica.

title: 4. Carbohydrates with fiber first
text: KEY CHOICE: Prioritize legumes, oats, whole grains and whole fruit over refined flour, pastries and juices. IMPACT: Fiber improves satiety and softens glucose peaks.
warning: Ajusta cantidad segun tus objetivos y medicacion para evitar hipoglucemias.

title: 5. Move your body for 150 minutes
text: WEEKLY GOAL: Accumulate at least 150 minutes of moderate activity. SIMPLE FORMAT: 30 minutes, 5 days per week, or blocks of 10 minutes.
warning: Si tienes complicaciones o dolor toracico/disnea, consulta antes de intensificar ejercicio.

title: 6. Strength two days a week
text: ACTIVE MUSCLE: Includes 2 strength sessions each week. METABOLIC ADVANTAGE: Improves insulin sensitivity and energy expenditure.
warning: Empieza con cargas progresivas y tecnica correcta para evitar lesiones.

title: 7. Buy with a closed list
text: ANTI-PICKING PLAN: Buy with a list and avoid ultra-processed aisles. RESULT: Fewer impulsive decisions and better adherence to the plan.
source: NHS Lifestyle Changes for Type 2 Diabetes
warning: Si vives con familia, pacta opciones comunes para sostener el cambio.

title: 8. Cook by technique, not by frying
text: RECOMMENDED TECHNIQUES: Oven, steam, iron and microwave to reduce calories from fat. FLAVOR: Use spices, herbs, lemon and vinegar to maintain palatability.
warning: Controla tambien aceites en crudo; sano no significa sin limite.

title: 9. Lean protein in each main meal
text: STABILITY: Adding lean protein helps control hunger and preserve muscle mass in calorie deficit. OPTIONS: Fish, eggs, legumes, poultry, tofu, natural dairy products.
warning: Si tienes nefropatia diabetica, ajusta proteina con tu especialista.

title: 10. Sleep routine of 7 to 8 hours
text: METABOLIC REST: Sleeping well helps control appetite, adherence and glucose. PRACTICAL STEP: Define a fixed rest schedule and reduce nighttime screens.
warning: Si roncas fuerte o hay somnolencia diurna, consulta para descartar apnea del sueno.

title: 11. Alcohol with maximum caution
text: CLINICAL RISK: Alcohol can cause late hypoglycemia if you take insulin or sulfonylureas. PRACTICAL RULE: If you drink, do so with food and monitor glucose.
warning: Consulta limites individuales con tu equipo sanitario.

title: 12. Don't smoke
text: DOUBLE DAMAGE: Diabetes and tobacco increase cardiovascular and vascular risk. BENEFIT: Quitting smoking improves prognosis and reduces complications.
warning: Busca apoyo estructurado si hay dependencia nicotinica.

title: 13. Progressive daily steps goal
text: MICROGOAL: Increase steps compared to your weekly average, not from a fixed ideal number. REAL SUCCESS: Sustainable progression beats perfect short-term plan.
warning: Con neuropatia o pie diabetico, el calzado y revision del pie son obligatorios.

title: 14. Check glucose around exercise
text: ACTIVE CONTROL: Measure glucose before and after exercise when you are adjusting your routine. SAFETY: This is how you detect hypoglycemia or excessive response to effort.
source: NIDDK - Stay Safe During Physical Activity
warning: Si hay glucosa muy alta o cetonas, no entrenes sin pauta medica.

title: 15. Emergency anti-hunger plan
text: QUICK KIT: Have controlled options ready (natural yogurt, fruit, nuts in closed portion). PREVENTION: You avoid impulsive choices at the end of the day.
source: NHS and NIDDK lifestyle adherence principles
warning: Respeta porcion; incluso opciones saludables pueden exceder calorias.

title: 16. Gradual adjustment week
text: SMART CHANGE: Introduce one improvement per week (drinks, portions, steps, sleep). SUSTAINABILITY: Less abandonment, more maintenance.
warning: Si hay descontrol glucemico persistente, no retrases consulta clinica.

title: 17. Quick label 3 points
text: EXPRESS FILTER: Compare sugars, saturated fats and sodium among similar products. DECISION: Choose the option with the best profile per 100 g or 100 ml.
warning: La etiqueta no sustituye el control de porciones.

title: 18. Complete cardiometabolic approach
text: BEYOND GLUCOSE: Controlling blood pressure, lipids and weight reduces diabetes complications. HABIT: Prioritize check-ups and goal monitoring.
warning: No ajustes medicacion por tu cuenta.

title: 19. Warning signs
text: QUICK CONSULTATION: If there is vomiting, high fever, persistent diarrhea, repeated hypoglycemia or sustained very high glucose, request urgent medical evaluation. SAFETY: Acting soon prevents complications.
source: NHS Type 2 Diabetes Treatment Urgent Advice; NIDDK DKA and hypoglycemia guidance
warning: En sintomas graves o confusion, usa urgencias de inmediato.

title: 20. Mandatory clinical message
text: HEALTH INFORMATION: These tips are educational and do not replace professional diagnosis or treatment. RECOMMENDATION: If you have diabetes, pregnancy, kidney disease, heart disease or clinical doubts, consult a doctor or dietician-nutritionist before intensive changes.
warning: Personaliza siempre con profesionales sanitarios.

title: 21. Plan menus for the week
text: ORGANIZATION: Planning menus in advance reduces improvisation and improves adherence. BENEFIT: You buy better, waste less and control portions better.
warning: Si usas insulina, mantem horarios coherentes de comida y seguimiento de glucosa.

title: 22. Make a closed shopping list
text: FIXED LIST: Going with a list avoids impulsive purchases of pastries and snacks. EXTRA: If you buy in season, it is usually cheaper and more varied.
warning: Revisa etiquetas basicas de azucar y grasas para comparar productos.

title: 23. Don't shop when hungry
text: SIMPLE TRICK: Go shopping after eating to avoid making craving choices. RESULT: Less ultra-processed foods at home and better weekly calorie control.
warning: Planifica snack saludable si la compra se alarga.

title: 24. Cook in batches and freeze portions
text: BATCH COOKING: Cooking once and freezing in small portions helps you avoid improvising high-calorie dinners. BENEFIT: You save time and maintain the plan.
warning: Etiqueta fecha y contenido para seguridad alimentaria.

title: 25. Use small plates
text: VISUAL PERCEPTION: A small plate makes it easier to control quantity without feeling empty. APPLICATION: Serve a portion in the kitchen and avoid leaving a dish on the table.
source: Hospital General Universitario Gregorio Maranon; International Diabetes Federation
warning: Si quedas con hambre frecuente, revisa composicion del plato, no solo volumen.

title: 26. Diet does not mean boring food
text: POSITIVE APPROACH: Eating for diabetes is not punishment, it is choosing better quality and portion. KEY: You can maintain flavor with spices, textures and simple recipes.
warning: Personaliza elecciones con nutricionista si hay objetivos clinicos especificos.
